entries.excerpt: Prefer a gamepad? Get to know another way to play World of Warcraft: Forever, from moving and casting spells to adjusting your settings. Gamepad support is available in a beta state, with more improvements to come. View Full Article

entries.title: WoW: Forever—What’s New and What Feels Familiar
entries.author: Blizzard Entertainment
entries.excerpt: World of Warcraft: Forever has something for explorers, dungeon groups, collectors, roleplayers, and PvP fans alike. entries.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Goes Live Globally November 4!
entries.author: Blizzard Entertainment
entries.excerpt: Begin your first adventure or return to a new and reimagined Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever, launching worldwide November 4 at 3:00 pm PST. Adventure to level 60 across the original continents, discover new stories, and meet fellow adventurers in a permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW where community comes first and the journey matters as much as the destination. View Full Article

entries.title: Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever
entries.author: Blizzard Entertainment
entries.excerpt: Welcome back to Azeroth. Whether it has been a few years, or many— familiar roads, old friends, and new adventures are waiting for you in World of Warcraft: Forever. To help you get your feet on the ground and begin your adventures in Azeroth once more, we’ve put together some information you may need to return to your hero’s journey. View Full Article
